critical_finding: The exact phrase 'alpine academy' (vol 3,600/mo nationally) is a HOMOGRAPH/NAME COLLISION identical in shape to the prior 'ski machine' finding — it is used generically by dozens of UNRELATED schools nationwide: a residential treatment facility for teens in Erda, Utah (alpineacademy.org, the #1 result), multiple unrelated charter schools (Sparks NV, Chubbuck ID), preschools (Lake Orion MI, Oviedo FL), and a California opportunity school. 'alpine academy' and 'alpine academy utah' return the IDENTICAL search volume (3,600/mo), confirming almost all of that volume is the Utah teen residential-treatment facility specifically, NOT ski/snow-sport instruction anywhere. Verified via SERP for both 'alpine academy' (national) and 'alpine academy arizona' — zero ski/snowboard-related results in either; 'alpine academy arizona' surfaces the unrelated public Alpine Elementary School/District in the actual town of Alpine, AZ (Apache County), plus the same Utah treatment facility. DO NOT target 'alpine academy' as an SEO phrase anywhere on this site, and DO NOT build this site as a teen residential-treatment/therapeutic-boarding-school business — that is a real, unrelated, highly-regulated business type (clinical licensing, distressed-family audience) with zero connection to what this build is for. The domain's brand name uses 'Alpine Academy' as a name only; all SEO targeting uses the real, verified Arizona ski/snowboard-instruction demand below instead.
market_reality_check: Real, large, verified demand exists around Arizona's own ski resorts and beginner/first-timer instruction — NOT a homograph, NOT ambiguous. 'arizona snowbowl' alone is 40,500/mo (Flagstaff's resort — the dominant informational/navigational term for AZ skiing). 'sunrise park resort' 18,100/mo (White Mountains resort near Greer). 'mount lemmon ski valley' 8,100/mo (Tucson-area resort). 'arizona ski resorts' 6,600/mo. SERP for 'ski lessons flagstaff' shows the resort's own site (snowbowl.ski) dominating lessons/rentals content, but a real independent instruction business already exists (skipro.com — 'Ski & Snowboarding Lessons in Arizona') and a nonprofit youth racing team (flagstaffskiclub.org) — confirming a private, non-resort ski/snowboard instruction business is a viable, real local-service category, just under-filled for the Phoenix-Valley-resident-prep angle specifically. PAA signals ('Is Arizona Snowbowl good for beginners?', 'How much does it cost to ski in Flagstaff?', 'Is Flagstaff good for skiing?') confirm strong first-timer/beginner search intent — most Phoenix-metro residents have never skied and are searching from a desert-city starting point, which is exactly this site's angle.
